riskAssessment.reason: The change tightens a deterministic promotion boundary and HTML body extraction. A false positive can mislabel document material as evidence; a false negative can hide a real claim, so both paths need explicit fixtures and fail-closed behavior.
riskAssessment.reviewNotes: The live dry-run showed eight Meta Engineering documents promoted from title/body material. The implementation must require a sentence-level body passage and preserve SEC facts independently.

preReviewWarnings: Do not let title text, script/JSON metadata, or an entry-point page become a claim passage.
Keep SEC Company Facts and filing-derived values on their existing path; this gate applies only to discovered document observations.
A real sentence-level claim may be promoted even when it does not imply a structural organization change; Ranking and judgment remain separate.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A discovered official document with an explicit body sentence becomes a claim candidate.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The candidate concrete_change and passage contain one bounded sentence with a change action, a production-system area, source title, effective date, and official provenance.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Use an HTML fixture with title, metadata, and a body paragraph such as 'Acme moved its engineering workflow to an agent-assisted scheduler.'; assert extraction returns the sentence rather than the full page.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Title-only or metadata-only documents do not promote.
scenarioCoverage.expected: A document containing only a title, script JSON, meta tags, or headings yields no claim candidate and remains a document/source observation.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run title-only, script-only, and heading-only HTML fixtures through document_metadata and extract_evidence_candidate; assert no candidate is returned.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: SEC financial facts remain unaffected by claim extraction tightening.
scenarioCoverage.expected: A valid Company Facts response still produces a Known revenue fact even when document claim extraction rejects material.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the existing partial SEC fixture test and the new combined regression assertion without any external HTTP request.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: The report keeps document discovery separate from validated evidence.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Rejected article material increments document/pending-lead paths but does not increment the validated-evidence metric or create a Ranking input.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Render a fixture report with rejected document candidates and zero validated evidence; assert the separate metrics and no machine Ranking output.

acceptance: Document metadata extraction removes title, script, style, and meta-only content from the body passage while retaining a separate bounded source title and explicit date.
EvidenceCandidate extraction uses a bounded sentence-level body passage containing a concrete change action and production-system signal; title/page-level text alone cannot promote.
ValidatedEvidence retains company identity, source title, effective date, authoritative tier, source URI, bounded passage, and deterministic provenance without full-page JSON payloads.
SEC financial facts, source availability observations, document candidate counts, and fail-closed Ranking behavior remain compatible with existing tests.
Focused, module, integration, architecture, and project quality checks pass with no external network or secret values.
The full AI Cockpit lifecycle completes with localized Finish evidence, PR CI, merge, closure, and clean branch/worktree state.
guidelines: New public APIs must be documented.
Do not import internal modules from other features.
Use deterministic rule-only extraction; never add LLM or probabilistic claim extraction.
Prefer false negatives to promoting title, metadata, homepage, or ambiguous document material.
Keep SEC, source acquisition, judgment, Ranking, Telegram, and archive behavior outside this Work Item.
Never claim a structural organization change merely because a technical document contains a production-system claim.

intent.problem: The live Weekly Radar dry-run discovered 76 document candidates and promoted eight Meta Engineering pages as new valid evidence, but their rendered facts still contained article-level/title-and-page material rather than a bounded claim passage. This blurs document discovery with evidence and can overstate Research Value.
constraints: Only official discovered Document observations may enter this claim gate; EntryPoint, HiringRecord, DiscoveryArticle, and status observations remain outside it.
The extractor must be deterministic, bounded, local, and rule-only; no LLM, paid API, or unbounded crawl is allowed.
SEC financial facts and existing source-availability semantics must remain unchanged.
A candidate needs company identity, what changed, effective date, production-system area, authoritative source, and a bounded original body passage before promotion.
The change must preserve the existing Ranking fail-closed behavior and distinguish rejected document material from validated evidence in reports.
intent.rationale: Separating clean body content from metadata and requiring a sentence-level claim makes the EvidenceCandidate boundary match ORG-X's evidence-first design. It improves calibration without manufacturing organization changes or hiding unavailable coverage.
